APPROVE

The `BuildPlan` branching is reduced to roughly 5 cognitive complexity points, the extracted helpers preserve the original Create/Apply matching, index selection, skip-on-no-match and closure semantics, and the nullable-tuple `is var (…)` pattern and target-typed `null` both compile cleanly. I could not build the project here, so the build condition rests on reading the code. A member-ordering analyzer, if enabled, could object to the `const` sitting between methods.
